# 1. The “Customer Support” Agent (Executing a Read Tool)

## Prompt used

A customer says their order is stuck. Their email is `ceo@entreprise.com`. Explicitly execute the MCP tool named `get_customer_status` to find the status of their order and draft an apologetic technical email.

## Name of the executed MCP Tool 

`get_customer_status`

## Order status returned by the CRM 

Delayed - Out of stock

## Email draft generated by the Agent

```
Subject: Update on your delayed order

Dear Customer,

I’m sorry to hear that your order is stuck and apologize for the delay. Our records show that it is currently delayed because the item is out of stock.

We understand the inconvenience this causes and are working to provide an updated fulfillment timeline. We appreciate your patience and sincerely regret the disruption.

Kind regards,
Customer Support Team
```
